metric_evidence.quote: our model with a smaller 7B-parameter LLM surpasses GPT-4o [8] on a set of zero-shot reasoning tasks on a variety of time-series domains.

summary: A trained time series encoder plus CoT fine-tuning lets a 7B LLM reason about series in text; it beats GPT-4o on zero-shot UCR classification and improves caption-based etiological reasoning over text input, with no targeted practical-problem experiment.
